currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — bounded OCR field-maintenance fix preview-verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: Real field use on 2026-09-18 exposed two OCR-review friction points: malformed sales previousClearAt could reach draft creation, and a manually corrected vendor number lacked an explicit apply/revalidation path. FINAL.16 fixes both without changing Analytics numeric behavior, inventory semantics, or automatic-confirmation policy. The branch is browser/IndexedDB/mobile preview-verified and is pending merge plus production verification.
scope: Block invalid sales previousClearAt / occurredAt / elapsedHours before draft creation and revalidate again at save time.
Keep OCR identity fields directly editable; a corrected vendor number must update the reviewed candidate and immediately re-run vending-machine matching.
Full-editor corrections must be explicitly applied back to the compact review before draft creation.
A corrected vendor number may surface a machine candidate but must never auto-link it; explicit user linkage remains required.
Use VENDRIVE normally after this bounded maintenance fix; do not turn the observed friction into a broader feature phase.
Production listForecasts output remains unchanged and AN15 learned numeric corrections remain evaluation-only.
OPS10C remains withdrawn; preserve existing Today nearest-machine ordering.
nextActions: Merge FINAL.16 after the verified maintenance gates, then verify the production deployment and live browser gate.
Resume normal field use and accumulate real exact scored samples without changing production numeric decisions.
Treat further repeated field friction, incorrect proposals, missing information, failed evidence accumulation, or measured forecast error as evidence for a separately scoped maintenance cycle.
Promote learned numeric corrections only after the existing held-out/no-lookahead gates pass.

unresolved: Numeric learning promotion requires sufficient real exact scored samples and held-out improvement evidence.
